notes.title: Integration with Buttplug.io and Lovense
notes.content:
Our game now supports popular devices such as Lovense, Kiiroo, The Handy, WeVibe, OSR-2/SR-6, and more. If you don't already own one, we recommend checking out Lovense's products, which are offering excellent Black Friday discounts. Currently, compatibility is limited to the Intiface Central application, but we plan to expand support to other apps in the future. Please send us your feedback and suggestions to help improve integration with app-controlled toys.
